issues.detail: PY/Y upper-tub grade compressed to just above the bezel, no shadow line under the lip
issues.problem: b_pyClose col 860 stays flat at 204 (0.94 of the pier) for the top ~60 % of the upper tub, then drops to 167 (0.77) just above the bezel. sp_py14 (cols 555 / 745) grades steadily over the whole upper tub, 186 -> 131 (0.70), and adds a distinct darker band (151-154 vs 186) just under the lip top, where the lip overhangs. Ours reads as a light tub with a smudge over the window rather than a sculpted hood. The cause is the ^0.7 exponent in tubF above oTop, which brightens quickly away from the opening.
issues.fix: src/07_shell.js l.322: change the upper branch exponent 0.7 -> 1.4 (lerp(fl,1,t**1.4)) and, for REC_Y, cap the top at 0.88 instead of 1 (lerp(fl,0.88,...)); then multiply by a lip-shadow term, e.g. *(1 - 0.12*sstep(clamp((d-(rec.top-0.07))/0.04,0,1))) applied only on the lip/sill rings (dv > rec.top-0.07), to get the darker band under the lip as in sp_py14. Keep the bottom at fl 0.42.

issues.detail: Residual faint vertical smudges at the bezel's top corners
issues.problem: The lateral fade wz starts at |z| 0.10, which is right at the bezel's upper corners (pane half-width 0.127 plus the frame). So the centre-to-side transition lands on the corner and leaves short soft vertical streaks (ra_yWin crop, b_pyClose right window, q12 right tub side).
issues.fix: l.321: start the fade nearer the centre and spread it, e.g. clamp((|z|-0.04)/(rec.hw-0.02-0.04)), with strength 0.55 instead of 0.65, so the gradient is wide and lies across the tub rather than on the corners.

issues.detail: Blackout pleat relief about half the photo's
issues.problem: The detrended stripe amplitude across the closed blackout is 0.136 of the mean in b_jClose, against 0.317 in omaat_room24. From the aisle (s05) the shade reads as a finely ribbed grey panel rather than crisp pleats with light ridges and dark valleys. The mean tone (0.57 of the bezel vs 0.60) is now right.
issues.fix: l.425: blackout kf 0.72 -> 0.60 and raise MAT.blackout to about '#a29c90', so the mean stays near 0.58-0.60 of the bezel while the valley/crest contrast roughly doubles. Re-check win_oblique for moire.

issues.detail: Galley/door vinyl lacks the cloudy stone mottle
issues.problem: The tone now matches (96,94,103 vs sans_09 104,100,106), but the L std is 7.2 against 26: the photo has large light/dark clouds at about 0.2-0.4 m scale. There is also a slight violet cast (h 257, s 0.09 vs s 0.05).
issues.fix: l.39: vinyl '#6f6b72' -> '#6e6c70' (less violet). Add low-frequency vertex-colour jitter on the vinyl boxes at l.581 (subdivide the box top into ~0.15 m quads and multiply each vertex by 1 + 0.18*noise(x*3, z*3)), or raise the LAYER.vinyl large-scale amplitude in LAYER_PARAMS (03_tex.js shared, one line).
